results.content: # Stock futures are little changed after S&P 500 sets record above 7,800, heads for winning week: Live updates. Stock futures were little changed early Friday after a record-setting session, with two of the three major benchmarks on pace for their third consecutive weekly advance. S&P 500 futures traded around the flatline, while Nasdaq-100 futures inched lower. In Asia, Japan's Nikkei 225 added 0.44% while the Topix rose 0.49%. Hong Kong's Hang Seng index was down 0.93%, while mainland China's CSI 300 inched 0.12% lower.
